summary.text: Judith Zaffirini is a Democratic member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 21 since 1987 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Julie Dahlberg. She holds bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees from the University of Texas at Austin and owns Zaffirini Communications.

paragraphs.text: Zaffirini earned bachelor's, graduate and Ph.D. degrees from the University of Texas at Austin and also studied at Laredo Community College and the University of Houston, according to Ballotpedia.
She worked as a teacher in higher education for more than 13 years and owns her own business, Zaffirini Communications.
She served as vice-chair of the Texas Democratic Party from 1984 to 1986 before running for the Democratic nomination for state Senate in 1986.
Zaffirini assumed office in the Texas State Senate in 1987.
In 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Business & Commerce, Finance, Special Committee on Redistricting and Senate State Affairs committees, as well as the Committee of the Whole Senate.
She defeated Cortney Jones in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with 73.2 percent of the vote.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Zaffirini described herself as the first Mexican American woman Texas state senator and the first woman Dean of the Texas Senate, and said she has passed more than 1,500 bills.
She said her top priorities include education, with a focus on early and higher education, and health and human services.
